M-EVOLVE-TYPES.Summary: Type surface for grace evolve — ProblemSpec, Candidate, MetricResult, TrialResult, EvolveArchive.

M-EVOLVE-SPEC.Summary: Read and validate a ProblemSpec from disk. Collects structured errors; never throws.

M-EVOLVE-METRIC.Summary: Parse numeric values out of command stdout; default picks the last numeric-only line.

M-EVOLVE-SCORE.Summary: Weighted min-max scoring across a cohort of trials, with per-metric direction and veto.

M-EVOLVE-RUNNER.Summary: Execute a single candidate inside a worktree — setup, metric commands, teardown — producing a TrialResult.

M-EVOLVE-WORKTREE.Summary: Create and tear down git worktrees per candidate. Isolation mandatory; a bad patch must never corrupt the base repo.

M-EVOLVE-ARCHIVE.Summary: Serialize EvolveArchive to XML at docs/experiments/<topic>/results.xml using GRACE unique-tag conventions. Atomic write via .tmp + rename.

M-EVOLVE-ORCHESTRATOR.Summary: Drive the full evolve loop: for each candidate, prepare worktree, run metrics, rescore cohort, apply stopping, emit archive.
